<!-- Written by `ecs-architecture agents` from the rules of @adobe/ecs-architecture and @adobe/ecs: run it again, never edit. -->

- A port connects an outside source, device input, network, storage or timers, independent of this feature's markup: it imports `model` and `ports`, never `view`, `elements` or `@adobe/ecs-gpu`.
- It's handed its targets and predicates through `PluginConfig`, never hardcoding a widget's selector. It exports its `Plugin`.
